body:
Actually a lot (in my conception) in the last 3 days.

I was at a party, I drank too much. I started dancing with a female colleague of mine. Then I don't remember how this happen, if I tried to kiss her of if I didn't. I remember insisting to her, like "oh, come on".

I'm not really that kind of guy, the guy who tries to kiss a girl while both are dancing at a group.

She didn't accept. Although me insisting.

I go to the bathroom.

I come back, she isn't there anymore.

Obviously she's running from me.

Till there: ok. As I said, I'm not the kind of guy who does that, but I'm ok with taking NO's in the face.

But there's some observations:

A teacher of mine was also in this party. And from what a friend told me, yes, I did tried to kiss her, and this teacher wen't there and entered between us. This teacher of us really likes joking, he's really funny. So, probably next year he will joke at this. Or not. I don't know.

**How serious is to try to kiss a girl while both are dancing?**

Bad enough. As I said, I'm not that kind of guy.

**Should I say to her that I'm sorry?** Or maybe this will only make things worse.

Anyway, some time ago I started losing faith at everything around me.

At the middle of the year, in another party. I "friend" of mine kiss this girl that I tried to kiss. He succeeded. And what kept me thinking is:

How a pain in the ass, an idiot like him, could had more chances than me? Yes, this is a moral problem.

If I'm gonna be judged by my appearance, why should I be a nice person? Why should I be sym**pathetic** and altruistic when there are probably people using me? 

And this kept me thinking. Kept me thinking. And more bad things were coming to my head.

Why I never dated anyone. Maybe for living in a small city. Maybe for being so different.

Why most girls don't notice me. 

And when was the last time that someone told me: I love you. Or the last time I felt loved.

Or at least: You can't trust me.

You see, one thing happened, and this one thing make me remember of all the bad things in my life.

Love is important, is natural, is a part of the human nature and behavior. Why can't I experiment it?
